The '''Imperial Throne Room''' of the [[Imperial Palace/Legends|Imperial Palace]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] served as the seat of the [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], ruler of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. That chamber was used from its construction circa [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]] until Palpatine's [[Death/Legends|demise]] aboard the [[Death Star II/Legends|second Death Star]] at the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|battle]] over [[Endor/Legends|Endor]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the Empire and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], Palpatine frequently summoned his trusted agents in the throne room, including [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]], and [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor]].

==History==
At the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], the [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] revealed his true nature as a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] and anointed himself [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|ruler]] of an authoritarian [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. He declared martial law and decreed the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|extermination]] of all [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], the long-time enemies of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]. Palpatine also ordered the refurbishment of the stately [[Imperial Palace/Legends|Presidential Palace]], making the tallest structure on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="UVG">''[[Star Wars: The Ultimate Visual Guide]]''</ref> By [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]], the changes to the Palace were completed.<ref name="CATCW">''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]'' Completion of the Palace refurbishment</ref> Several audience chambers were integrated into the building, each designed to serve a specific need. One of them served as the Palpatine's public [[Throne/Legends|throne]] room, where [[Bureaucrat/Legends|bureaucrats]] and honored citizens were summoned to listen to the Emperor's decrees.<ref name="SOEsb">''[[Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook]]''</ref>

[[File:Vader_before_the_throne.png|thumb|left|200px|Darth Vader kneels before his master's throne.]]
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] that pitted the Empire against the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], Emperor Palpatine frequently summoned [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] to his favorite throne room for important matters. Shortly [[Galactic Standard Calendar|before]] the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]<ref name="NEGTC">''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]''</ref> the Empire discovered the location of the [[The Dark Woman|Dark Woman]], a Jedi who had survived the Jedi purge. Palpatine summoned Vader in the throne room, informing him of the situation, and ordering him to travel to [[Cophrigin V]] so he could [[Death/Legends|kill]] the survivor.<ref name="Extinction">{{Tales|issue1=1|issue2=2|Extinction}}</ref> Not long thereafter, the Empire's planet-killing [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]] [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]] was destroyed by the Rebel Alliance in the [[Yavin system/Legends|Yavin system]]. While trying to find the location of the [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|young pilot]] responsible for the destruction of the Death Star, Vader made reports to the Emperor in the Palace throne room.<ref name="VQ2">[[Vader's Quest 2|''Vader's Quest'' 2]]</ref>

Besides Darth Vader, Emperor Palpatine maintained contact with other agents in his throne room, including his [[Emperor's Hand/Legends|elite operative]] [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]],<ref name="MJ">''[[Star Wars: Mara Jade – By the Emperor's Hand]]''</ref> and [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor]] of the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]].<ref name="SOEcomic">[[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (comic series)|''Shadows of the Empire'']] (comics)</ref> It is also in that room that Palpatine relieved [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Tiaan Jerjerrod/Legends|Tiaan Jerjerrod]] from his work in [[Logistics and Supply]], naming him sole [[Commander/Legends|commander]] of the still-under-construction [[Death Star II/Legends|second Death Star]] [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]].<ref name="ITES">{{WEGCite|story=In the Emperor's Service|book=Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook}}</ref>

==Layout==
[[File:Throneroom-SOTE.png|thumb|250px|The throne room was a vast auditorium with large windows and a dais.]]
Sunken into the [[Stone/Legends|stone]], the Emperor's primary throne room was an immense auditorium<ref name="SOEsb" /> that could be divided in two sections. The first section, through which visitors entered the room,<ref name="SOE" /> was an antechamber<ref name="ITES" /> with curved walls and a number of stations occupied by [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]]. The second section was an apse that contained the throne itself, perched atop a dais. Additional stations used by members of the [[Emperor's Royal Guard/Legends|Emperor's Royal Guard]] jutted from the dais to either sides of the throne. Three circular [[Window/Legends|windows]] lined with a web-like framework were located behind the throne and on both sides of it. A fourth, much larger window occupied the upper register of the back wall.<ref name="SOE" /> At the other end of the antechamber, facing the throne, was a [[Turbolift/Legends|turbolift]] access<ref name="Allegiance">[[Allegiance (novel)|''Allegiance'']]</ref> that lead to the [[Supplicants Waiting Hall]], where courtiers waited for an audience with their Imperial master.<ref name="ITES" />
